mapper.sql: uc.user_card_id, uc.card_product_id, uc.first4 AS maskedFrontNumber, uc.last4 AS maskedRearNumber, uc.expiry_date, uc.bank_name, uc.balance, uc.credit_limit, uc.scheduled_payment_amount, uc.display_order, cp.card_name, cp.card_type, i.card_company_name AS issuerName, cp.card_image_url
mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id, uc.card_product_id, cp.card_name, i.card_company_name, cp.card_image_url, cp.card_type, uc.last4, uc.scheduled_payment_amount FROM user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id JOIN issuer i ON i.issuer_id = cp.issuer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{cardId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0

SELECT uc.user_card_id, uc.card_product_id, cp.card_name, i.card_company_name, cp.card_image_url, cp.card_type, uc.bank_name, uc.balance FROM user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id JOIN issuer i ON i.issuer_id = cp.issuer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{cardId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0

SELECT ce.event_id, CASE WHEN ce.card_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CARD_PRODUCT' WHEN ce.issuer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ISSUER' END AS target_type, ce.summary, ce.starts_at, ce.ends_at, DATEDIFF(ce.ends_at, #{today}) AS days_remaining, ce.detail_url, CASE WHEN ce.detail_url REGEXP '^https?://[^[:space:]]+$' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS detail_available FROM user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id JOIN card_event ce ON ce.card_product_id = cp.card_product_id OR ce.issuer_id = cp.issuer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{cardId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0 AND ce.starts_at <= #{today} AND ce.ends_at >= #{today} ORDER BY ce.ends_at ASC, ce.starts_at DESC, ce.event_id ASC

SELECT pt.payment_transaction_id, s.store_name, c.category_name, c.category_image_url, pt.amount, pt.paid_at FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = pt.user_card_id LEFT JOIN store s ON s.store_id = pt.store_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = s.category_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{cardId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0 AND pt.paid_at >= #{condition.startAt} AND pt.paid_at < #{condition.endAt} ORDER BY pt.paid_at DESC, pt.payment_transaction_id DESC

SELECT uc.card_product_id, cp.card_name, i.card_company_name, cp.card_type FROM user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id JOIN issuer i ON i.issuer_id = cp.issuer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{cardId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0

SELECT bs.service_id, bs.plan_group_id, bs.benefit_name, bs.benefit_type, bs.value_type, bs.value_number, bs.min_payment_amount, bs.max_payment_amount, pc.currency_name, bt.tier_id, bt.tier_order, bt.min_prev_month_spend, bt.max_prev_month_spend FROM benefit_service bs LEFT JOIN point_currency pc ON pc.point_currency_id = bs.point_currency_id LEFT JOIN benefit_tier bt ON (bs.plan_group_id IS NOT NULL AND bt.plan_group_id = bs.plan_group_id) OR (bs.plan_group_id IS NULL AND bt.service_id = bs.service_id) WHERE bs.card_product_id = #{cardProductId} ORDER BY bs.service_id, bt.tier_order, bt.tier_id

SELECT bs.service_id, bs.benefit_name, bs.benefit_type, bs.value_type, bs.value_number, bs.scope_type, bs.min_payment_amount, bs.max_payment_amount, bs.per_tx_limit_amount, pc.currency_name, pc.krw_per_point, bt.tier_id, bs.plan_group_id service_plan_group_id, bt.plan_group_id limit_plan_group_id, bt.tier_order, bt.min_prev_month_spend, bt.max_prev_month_spend, bl.limit_id, bl.limit_basis, bl.limit_value FROM benefit_service bs JOIN benefit_tier bt ON (bs.plan_group_id IS NOT NULL AND bt.plan_group_id = bs.plan_group_id) OR bt.service_id = bs.service_id JOIN benefit_limit bl ON bl.tier_id = bt.tier_id AND bl.limit_period = 'MONTH' LEFT JOIN point_currency pc ON pc.point_currency_id = bs.point_currency_id WHERE bs.card_product_id = #{cardProductId} ORDER BY bs.service_id, bt.tier_id, bl.limit_id

SELECT bs.service_id, c.category_id, c.category_name, c.category_image_url FROM benefit_service bs JOIN service_category sc ON sc.service_id = bs.service_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = sc.category_id WHERE bs.card_product_id = #{cardProductId} AND bs.scope_type = 'INDUSTRY' ORDER BY bs.service_id, c.category_id

SELECT bs.service_id, b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.brand_image_url, c.category_id, c.category_name, c.category_image_url FROM benefit_service bs JOIN service_brand sb ON sb.service_id = bs.service_id JOIN brand b ON b.brand_id = sb.brand_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = b.category_id WHERE bs.card_product_id = #{cardProductId} AND bs.scope_type = 'BRAND' ORDER BY bs.service_id, b.brand_id

SELECT pt.applied_benefit_service_id service_id, s.category_id, s.brand_id, COUNT(*) transaction_count, COALESCE(SUM(pt.amount), 0) total_payment_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bs.point_currency_id IS NOT NULL THEN pt.discount_amount * pc.krw_per_point ELSE pt.discount_amount END), 0) received_benefit_amount FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = pt.user_card_id LEFT JOIN store s ON s.store_id = pt.store_id LEFT JOIN benefit_service bs ON bs.service_id = pt.applied_benefit_service_id LEFT JOIN point_currency pc ON pc.point_currency_id = bs.point_currency_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{cardId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0 AND pt.applied_benefit_service_id IS NOT NULL AND pt.paid_at >= #{condition.startAt} AND pt.paid_at < #{condition.endAt} GROUP BY pt.applied_benefit_service_id, s.category_id, s.brand_id ORDER BY pt.applied_benefit_service_id, s.category_id, s.brand_id

SELECT
FROM user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id JOIN issuer i ON i.issuer_id = cp.issuer_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_card_id, MAX(paid_at) AS last_paid_at FROM payment_transaction GROUP BY user_card_id ) recent_payment ON recent_payment.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id
WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY CASE WHEN recent_payment.last_paid_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, recent_payment.last_paid_at DESC, uc.display_order ASC, uc.user_card_id ASC
ORDER BY uc.display_order ASC, uc.user_card_id ASC
